descriptionChirho: Active Qal finite forms and infinitives meaning to avenge or take vengeance upon an enemy or wrongdoer.
Qal active participle used substantivally or attributively to denote an avenger or one who takes vengeance.
Nifal reflexive and middle-voice forms meaning to avenge oneself or to obtain vengeance for oneself.
Piel intensive stem expressing the vigorous or thorough execution of vengeance.
Hitpael reflexive-intensive forms denoting self-avenging, often with iterative or emphatic nuance.
Hofal passive and Qal passive forms indicating that vengeance is enacted upon or on behalf of someone.
